# invites.blog

> Premium animated invitation platform. Inviters build personalized, role-aware digital invitations
> from a template gallery with no account required; invitees open a per-guest link and RSVP with
> zero login.

## Guest lists

- [Guest list guide](/guide/guest-list): how to format a guest list for upload (columns, required fields,
  common mistakes), with a [downloadable blank .xlsx template](/guest-list-template.xlsx).

## Help centre

- [Guides](/guide): step-by-step guides for organisers and guests — [your account](/guide/account),
  [creating an event](/guide/create-an-event), [animated invitations](/guide/animated-invitations),
  [your own design](/guide/your-own-design), [sharing and sending](/guide/sharing),
  [photo buckets](/guide/photo-buckets), [your feed](/guide/feed) and
  [people the event is for](/guide/celebrants).
